entities.name: Jon
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A former banker who lost his banking job on 19 January 2023 and spent the rest of the year building his own dance studio. He has danced since childhood and calls it his escape and stress-buster, favours contemporary, rehearsed with a dance crew that won a local competition in 2022, held his studio's official opening night on 20 June 2023, and by 21 July 2023 had taken a temporary job to cover expenses while looking for investors. A close friend of Gina.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description: The other speaker. She lost her job at Door Dash in January 2023 and became an entrepreneur, designing a clothing store and opening it online on 16 March 2023. She dances for stress relief, favours contemporary, competed as a teenager and won a regional competition at fifteen, has a tattoo standing for freedom, and took a part-time fashion internship at an international company in May 2023. Jon's close friend and his most constant supporter.

entities.name: Shia LaBeouf
entities.description: The actor whom Gina identified on 23 July 2023 as the source of the "Just do it" motivational speech she quoted at Jon. Not a participant in the conversation.

entities.name: Jon's dance studio

properties.aliases: the dance studio; my studio; the studio; my biz; the dance studio business

entities.description: The dance studio Jon set out to open after losing his banking job in January 2023, and the central subject of the conversation. He wanted a space by the water with Marley flooring, searched for premises through the spring, worked on a business plan and hunted investors, and held the official opening night on 20 June 2023. He teaches classes and workshops there, offers one-on-one mentoring, and by 21 July 2023 described the studio as on tenuous ground.

entities.name: Gina's clothing store

properties.aliases: my clothing store; my online clothing store; my online store; the store; my shop

entities.description: Gina's clothing business, treated here as one venture: the store space she designed in early 2023 and the online clothes store she opened on 16 March 2023. She promoted it with an ad campaign, secured a wholesaler on 1 February 2023, collaborated with a local artist, added dance-inspired pieces, made a limited-edition line in June 2023 and built an ordering website in July 2023. Merged as one entity because Gina uses "my store", "my online store" and "my business" interchangeably for it.

entities.name: Door Dash
entities.description: The delivery company Gina worked for until she lost her job there in January 2023, which is what pushed her into starting her own clothing business.

entities.name: Jon's dance crew

properties.aliases: my dance crew; a small group of dancers; my dancers

entities.description: The small group of dancers Jon rehearsed with after work, covering styles from contemporary to hip-hop. They took first place at a local competition in 2022 and performed at a nearby festival in February 2023 after finishing the choreography in January.

entities.name: the international company where Gina took a fashion internship

properties.aliases: an international company; the fashion department

entities.description: The unnamed international company whose fashion department gave Gina a part-time internship. She interviewed for it on 10 May 2023, calling it a design internship, and announced on 27 May 2023 that she had been accepted for a fashion internship; joined as one because the dates and the description match.

entities.name: dancing
entities.description: Dance, the shared passion that connects Jon and Gina and runs through every session. Jon has danced since childhood and calls it his escape, his stress-buster and where he feels most alive; Gina calls it her stress relief and says she cannot picture life without it. Both competed when younger, and both built their businesses around it.

entities.name: contemporary dance
entities.description: The dance style both Jon and Gina named on 20 January 2023 as their favourite — Jon calls it expressive and powerful, Gina expressive and graceful. It is also the style of "Finding Freedom", the piece Gina's team won a regional competition with.

entities.name: fashion
entities.description: Fashion, Gina's second passion alongside dance. It drives her clothing store, her hunt for trends and unique pieces, her collaboration with a local artist, her limited-edition line, and the part-time internship in an international company's fashion department she took in May 2023. She describes fashion as what fuels her creativity while dance is what relieves her stress.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city Jon visited on 28 January 2023 and described as very cool. Gina said the same day that she had never had the chance to visit it.

entities.name: Rome
entities.description: The city Gina said on 29 January 2023 she had visited once, and where Jon took a short trip in the week before 19 June 2023 to clear his mind.

entities.name: Finding Freedom
entities.description: The contemporary dance piece Gina's team performed to take first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen. She described it as really emotional and powerful, and it is her favourite competition memory.

entities.name: The Lean Startup
entities.description: The business book Jon was reading in May 2023 hoping for tips for his dance studio. He said it got him thinking about building a focused, efficient business and about adapting from customer feedback, which he intended to try.

entities.name: Jon's whiteboard
entities.description: The whiteboard on which Jon tracks ideas, milestones and dates for his dance studio business, giving him a visual of his progress. He colour-codes achievements on it so he can see how far he has come and stay motivated.

claims.text: On 23 July 2023 Gina told Jon that every step was getting him closer to his dream and Jon said he would keep going whatever came his way.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon's dance studio went from a decision taken the day after he lost his banking job on 19 January 2023, through five months of hunting for premises and looking for investors, to an official opening night on 20 June 2023 — and by 21 July 2023 it was on tenuous ground, with Jon taking a temporary job to cover expenses.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina's clothing business went from losing her job at Door Dash in January 2023, through designing a store space and securing a wholesaler on 1 February 2023, to opening her online clothing store on 16 March 2023 and being noticed by fashion editors in early July 2023.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina moved from running her clothing store alone to also holding a part-time fashion internship at an international company, interviewing on 10 May 2023 and announcing on 27 May 2023 that she had been accepted.
claims.speaker: Gina
